messages:
maria_support: FYI acme-app on prod-usw2 is reporting a wave of 502/504s starting ~08:12 UTC, customer seeing ~5-8% of requests fail. They attached a few failed request IDs. Repro steps below. Can we triage?

sam_support: Thanks Maria — what model + SDK version are they using? any pattern on embeddings vs generate? severity P1 for now since customer impact is revenue-facing.

maria_support: They're on model:redwood/open-6b-infer, SDK v1.3.2, mostly generate calls with streaming enabled. One example request id: req_0b3f9a2e. They noted higher incidence when sending 8-10 concurrent requests with ~2k token prompts.

kevin_sre: Looking at edge logs for prod-usw2 at that window — we see connection queueing and a flurry of upstream resets. Snippet:
```
2025-11-14T08:11:58Z edge-proxy[ingress-12] conn-queue=78 -> backlog-warning
2025-11-14T08:12:02Z edge-proxy[ingress-12] upstream-reset req=req_0b3f9a2e code=504
2025-11-14T08:12:05Z edge-proxy[ingress-12] conn-queue=120 -> accept-throttle
```
Looks like keepalive exhaustion + short window for new conns. No config deploys at that time.

juna_engine: Repro steps + quick local test: I can reproduce a 504 with client pattern: 8 concurrent streaming generate requests, 2k prompt, small client RTT (50ms). The runtime instance logs show long KV cache lock waits during prefix-heavy requests. Hypothesis: high concurrency + long seq -> blocking on kvcache serialization leading to per-request latency spike -> upstream timeout from proxy.

maria_support: Customer says they only started ramping concurrency last week (auto-scale change). They can throttle on their side but want a platform fix.

kevin_sre: Short-term mitigation: 1) Route acme-app traffic to a less-loaded ingress pool (usw2-bypass) — I can flip LB rule for them if approved. 2) Suggest client-side: reduce concurrent streams to 4 and enable exponential backoff on 502/504. 3) Increase proxy keepalive timeout from 60s -> 90s as temporary. Will open a hotfix PR.

lena_product: +1 on customer comms saying were investigating and listing mitigations. Please include ETA.

maria_support: I'll send customer an interim note: "We see transient ingress backlog causing 502/504s. Temporary mitigations: reduce concurrency, switch to non-streaming generate for large prompts, and enable exponential backoff. We're routing your traffic to an alternate pool now; ETA 15m. We'll follow up with a permanent fix." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: Good. I'm already creating the LB rule change. Deploybot: posting planned config change (keepalive) and a canary to ingress-12 now.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: ingress-config/keepalive-90s -> canary on ingress-12 -> start 2025-11-14T08:28:00Z. CI green.

juna_engine: For longer term: we should add non-blocking KV cache paths for prefix-heavy streaming, and add per-model concurrency guidance into docs/Optimize. Also consider autoscaling poisoning threshold: if queue > 80, spawn more runtime pods.

sam_support: Can we get an ETA for a code fix vs infra tweak? Customer asked for timeline.

kevin_sre: Infra tweaks (LB reroute + keepalive bump) within 30m. Runtime change is an engineering ticket — initial spike mitigation + patch in ~2 weeks, rollout in ~3-4 weeks. I'll add a rollback plan.

maria_support: Sent update to customer (ACME): "We routed traffic to alternate ingress and applied an ingress config change; please test and let us know if you still see >1% errors. We'll monitor for the next 2 hours and follow up with root cause and durable fix timeline."

lena_product: Customer-facing note looks good. Make sure billing/usage unaffected and note we won't double-bill for retried requests in that window.

kevin_sre: Monitoring: p95 latency for generate dropped from 1.2s -> 300ms after reroute; 5xx rate fell to ~0.2%. Keeping watch.

maria_support: Closing loop here — I'll keep thread open for updates. If error rate creeps back up, please @kevin_sre and @juna_engine.

sam_support: Thanks team. I'll update internal incident doc and CS owner. :white_check_mark:
